facts.text: I want to analyze my social media usage over the past month.
I use Facebook regularly.
I use Instagram regularly.
I use Twitter regularly.
I use LinkedIn regularly.
I use WhatsApp regularly.
I have access to my login credentials for each social media platform I use.
I do not use any third-party apps or browser extensions to track my screen time or social media usage.
I have set daily time limits on my social media apps.
I have been using WhatsApp a lot lately for a new project at work.
I have been in constant touch with my team for the new project at work.
I sent around 50 messages per day on average on WhatsApp during a 3-day period last week.
I finalized our project plan with my team during a 3-day period last week.
My WhatsApp usage increased significantly due to the new project.
My Facebook usage increased slightly during the same period.
I joined a few new groups related to my hobbies during the same period.
I engaged more with people in those hobby groups during the same period.
I posted a photo of my recent hike to Mount Everest Base Camp on Facebook.
I got around 20 likes and 5 comments within a day on that Facebook photo.
I use Instagram to keep up with my friends and family who live abroad.
I follow around 150 accounts on Instagram.
I try to scroll through my Instagram feed at least once a day.
Last week, I posted a story about my birthday celebration on Instagram.
I got around 30 replies from friends and family to my Instagram birthday story.
I responded to most of the Instagram birthday story replies individually.
I have been struggling to stick to my daily time limits on social media apps.
I often exceed my daily time limits on social media apps.
I exceed my daily time limits especially when it comes to Twitter.
I scroll through my Twitter feed for at least an hour every day.
I follow the news and trends closely on Twitter.
